Store a Playwright storage state as a session

Usage:
  kaab sessions create --file STATE.json --name NAME [flags]

Flags:
      --concurrency string   exclusive or shared
      --file string          a Playwright storageState JSON file
  -h, --help                 help for create
      --name string          the session's name
      --origin stringArray   an origin the session is for (repeatable)

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
